cryptoDependencyProposal.basis: Exact unverified proposal; no existing pin found in bounded services manifest/lock source search. Parent owns manifest integration. No install, network lookup or runtime import performed.

signingProfile.signature: 64-byte Ed25519 signature as exact 128-character lowercase hexadecimal
signingProfile.integers: Canonical nonnegative decimal strings, bounded signed 64-bit; ownerEpoch/revision positive
signingProfile.nonce: Exactly 64 lowercase hex characters, independently issued; never generated by this verifier
signingProfile.transitionEncoding: SHA256(existing authority canonical encoding of exact snake_case NativeEpochTransition fields); every epoch/sequence integer becomes its canonical decimal string. The envelope ownerEpoch equals current_owner_epoch. Prior epoch is positive and strictly lower than current, and both projection and journal sequences are positive. Every hash is lowercase SHA256.
signingProfile.transitionRetrieval: installed_approval_bytes(approval_id) returns exact original public signed envelope, including after consumption, for independent server verification. Retrieval never proves current authority or resets once-only state.
signingProfile.transitionLedger: vertex-native-approval-ledger-v3 retains UNIQUE transition_sha plus UNIQUE replay_sha in the existing approval audit. Epoch transition remains direct once-only consumption with no capital preparation. Earlier enrollment/schema versions fail closed without automatic migration.
signingProfile.replayDataclass: NativeOutboxReplay(grant_binding_bytes: bytes), frozen. from_grant(grant, authority=...) validates actual native public grant and encodes its binding; direct constructor accepts pre-sign original canonical binding bytes without inventing a signature.
signingProfile.replayEncoding: SHA256(existing authority canonical PUBLIC camelCase NativeOutboxReplayGrant excluding ONLY approvalBase64). This is deliberately NOT the private snake_case transition recipe. Verify reconstructs full NativeOutboxReplayGrant from stored original signature and requires native authority validation.
signingProfile.replayBinding: grantId equals approvalId; currentOwnerEpoch equals signed envelope ownerEpoch; account/paper scope matches enrollment; issuedAt/expiresAt exact epoch_ns equal signed issuedNs/expiresNs. serviceActorId is the native emitter/recipient principal, never the independent human signer actorId. Ordered row identities, raw/proof hashes, journal/fence evidence hashes and starting cloud head are retained verbatim in the signed binding.
signingProfile.retainedTransitionV4: NativeOutboxReplayGrant.retainedEpochTransitionSha256 is REQUIRED and nullable; exact explicit null remains in ordinary signed binding, or lowercase SHA256 binds the exact original canonical retained PortfolioEpochTransition sidecar bytes. No field stripping/default insertion occurs before replay hashing. Public replay.retainedEpochTransitionBase64 carries the corresponding required nullable original sidecar; parent/native batch schema enforces null parity, <=1MiB sidecar, zero starting head and exact first old-genesis snapshot binding within unchanged 8MiB decoded/12MiB wire limits.
signingProfile.historicalApprovalBoundary: Historical retained epoch approval is provenance, never current native replay authority. Current independently signed native-outbox-replay approval must ratify the retained sidecar SHA under current owner/policy/revocation/expiry. Historical original signature validity at issuance and CURRENT historical key/approvalId/nonce revocation are separate independent evidence-verifier responsibilities. Expired original approval is only eligible with fresh current replay ratification; this verifier never extends old signature authority.
signingProfile.replayRetry: First verify inserts a single consumed audit receipt. Exact same replay digest can subsequently verify only when that receipt exists and current signature, same owner epoch, policy/version, expiry and signed revocation status all still pass. No new nonce, grant or receipt is issued; changed rows/head/recipient/evidence deny.
signingProfile.subjectEncoding: Exact native dataclass field names; nanoseconds, source/journal sequences and owner epoch encode as decimal strings; positions encode as ordered arrays. Public approval_subject helper only builds hashes, never signatures or authority.

configuration.explicitOpen: open_configured(now_ns=...) reads a pinned local statusFile and explicitly opens initialize/restore audit. Constructor/open(initialize=...) remain available for direct injection.
configuration.trust: Independently enrolled exact public key bytes and role IDs, distinct key materials, independently reviewed policy digest/version. A cloud worker token is never accepted as a signature or enrollment.
configuration.default: DisabledNativeApprovalAuthority returns False; closed/unopened verifier also returns False. No key, amount, policy, status, approval, bootstrap, rearm or reset default exists.

consumption: Fresh signed monotonic status snapshot is verified inside each consumption transaction; revoked keys, approval IDs or nonces deny.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus UNIQUE approval ID, nonce, observation digest and audit stage prevents multiple concurrent consumptions.

Seed policy verify prepares idempotently. The exact separately signed observation requires prepared state, correct seed amount/artifact/currency/empty positions/source sequence and bounded observation age, then consumes the same approval once.
Subsequent observations and exact mutation grants consume once; replayed install never resets consumed state.

Cancel simulator transport uses a narrow read-only handoff, not a second approval consumption: NativeApprovalAuthority.verify_consumed accepts cancel-simulation only, current signature/status/epoch, exact canonical full grant and existing consumed audit operation hash. Ordinary verify remains once-only for all mutations.

SimulatorMutationAuthority(delegate,journal) in native_approval_transport.py must wrap the simulator only. It requires current durable journal epoch, owned order cancelRequested and dispatchMarked, exact original cancel-request event grantId/submissionKey/payloadSha256, canonical stored event bytes/hash and retained chain links, before the delegate's consumed receipt check. Existing marker does not contain evidenceSha256; that binding comes from the exact full signed MutationGrant digest, never an invented marker field. No journal/approval rows or actions are written by this handoff.

The independent approval DB does not participate in an atomic transaction with the native execution journal. Mutation/seed/epoch-transition failures after consumption burn authorization and require separately reviewed recovery. Only an exact native-outbox-replay batch may retry through its existing consumed receipt under current rights; this grants no new risk, order, seed or facts.

Initialize exclusively creates a new 0600 file in an owned 0700 directory; restore requires exact enrollment fingerprint. No automatic deletion, truncation, migration, key rotation or nonce pruning. Audit fills at 100000 approvals and fails closed.
Parent must hold its single native actor/owner transaction boundary while invoking verifier and authoritative owner methods. No cloud route or control credential grants native approval.
unverifiedLimitations: No tests, builds, typechecks, imports, lints, formatters, probes, installs, network, DB operations, key generation, approvals, signatures, bootstrap or mutations were executed during this source handoff.
Regressions are authored only and use publicly known synthetic test seeds exclusively when eventually run.
Cryptography version/backend, transitive dependency closure and platform durability behavior remain unverified; no real public keys or approval artifacts were read or issued.
Host caller supplies trusted current time and local current owner epoch; this verifier does not authenticate arbitrary caller Python code or prevent local privileged tampering.
Signed revocation freshness is bounded by reviewed maximumStatusAgeNs; no remote revocation callback or claim of instantaneous offline revocation.

Filesystem snapshot rollback of the entire approval database cannot be detected by this standalone local ledger. Release/restore operation must preserve the latest durable audit or require independently reviewed recovery; never restore an older nonce ledger silently.

The native owner transition signature binds exact snapshot/journal/outbox/fence evidence hashes but does not establish factual lock ownership or durable journal lineage by itself. Parent exporter and independent control NativeOwnerGrant verifier must reconstruct and validate original evidence, current enrollment/revocation and independent atomic transition nonce consumption.

V4 retained sidecar schema/hash amendment is source-only. Native approval verifies the exact current replay grant including retainedEpochTransitionSha256; it does not receive or verify original historical sidecar bytes itself. Parent evidence and independent server verifier must enforce historical signature-at-issuance and current revocation checks without treating old approval as current authority.
Approved native observations still require authoritative owned journal sequence/head and reconciliation checks. Approval alone neither changes balances nor authorizes broker/live execution.

Original seed_simulation builds time-dependent observation bytes; parent uses an explicitly supplied exact signed observation and separate policy preparation rather than fabricating timestamps or automatic reset/reconciliation.
